description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1791/24 of 03.01.2013, in Atthidiya-South, Ratmalana D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 521002 and other Amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcel numbers, land extents, ownership details, and corrections to land title records for various properties in the Colombo District. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership details, and amendments to land title records.
